name: Pancakes at the North Pole at Main Event Greensboro
when_note: Sunday, December 13, 2026, check-in 10:45 AM, activities 11 AM to 1:30 PM
paras: Main Event on Guilford College Road in Greensboro hosts Pancakes at the North Pole on Sunday, December 13, 2026. Check-in is at 10:45 AM, and the pancake breakfast runs from 11:30 AM to 1:30 PM while kids decorate sugar cookies, write letters to Santa and color seasonal pages in a coloring contest.

Each ticket includes two hours of unlimited activities and one hour of game play, plus a digital meet and greet photo with Santa's pals. An individual ticket is $35.96 and a family 4-pack is $108.96, or $27.24 per person, with tax and gratuity included. Children must be with an adult, and kids under 2 come in with an adult ticket.
tip: Buy the family 4-pack if you have a group of four, and arrive by 10:45 AM for check-in.

name: Pancakes at the North Pole at Main Event Fayetteville
when_note: Sunday, December 13, 2026, check-in 10:45 AM, activities 11 AM to 1:30 PM
paras: Main Event at Cross Creek Mall in Fayetteville serves Pancakes at the North Pole on Sunday, December 13, 2026, starting with check-in at 10:45 AM. Families build their own pancakes at the breakfast, then split time between the craft area and the arcade until about 1:30 PM.

Tickets are $35.96 for one person or $108.96 for a family of four, and both prices include tax and gratuity. The ticket covers two hours of unlimited activities, an hour on a game card, sugar cookie decorating, Santa letters, a coloring contest and a digital photo with Santa's pals. An adult must stay with every child.
tip: Check in at the Cross Creek Mall entrance by 10:45 AM so the kids start the crafts at 11.

name: Breakfast with Santa at HomeTrust Park
paras: The Asheville Tourists host Breakfast with Santa at HomeTrust Park, 30 Buchanan Place, on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 9 to 11 AM. Santa and Mrs. Claus visit after a buffet of scrambled eggs, bacon, sausage, breakfast potatoes, mini pancakes with toppings and spiced apples, with juice, coffee or tea.

Kids play reindeer games and meet Santa and Mrs. Claus, and photos with Santa are free though a photographer is not included. Adult tickets are $31.50 and child tickets are $21.50. Both ticket types showed as sold out on November 27, so call the Tourists at 828-575-1011 to ask about openings.
tip: Tickets sold out early, so call the Tourists before you plan a trip.
